$comment: P68 round 9 (lane `cs`) — a predefined function-name identifier used OUTSIDE every function body. C 6.4.2.2 declares `__func__` only inside a function definition, so DSS refused a file-scope use S_UndeclaredIdentifier — below the union. MEASURED 2026-09-23, each reference separately and RUN: gcc 13.3.0 at -std=c2x (a pedwarn; -std=c17 -pedantic-errors refuses), clang 18.1.3 at both modes (-Wpredefined-identifier-outside-function) and mingw-w64 13.2.0 at -std=c2x accept this very file and exit 42, agreeing the object is the EMPTY string; MSVC 19.51 refuses (C2065). DSS now binds one file-scope twin per configured spelling in the language's builtin scope (text "", the per-function symbol's shape) and reports S_PredefinedIdentifierOutsideFunction at each use outside a body — the four positions below, and NOT the in-body use on the last line, which is still `main`'s own name. exit 42 = 1 (sizeof "" in an enum) + 1 (the configured alias `__FUNCTION__`) + 1 (g[0] == 0) + 34 (a file-scope array of sizeof("") + 33 elements) + 5 ("main" and its NUL, inside the body). RED-ON-DISABLE: drop the file-scope mint -> the build fails S_UndeclaredIdentifier; drop the use-site warning -> the expectWarnings set is empty and the entry fails. Release pipeline + all four targets.
